round1_verdicts_immutable.note: mechanical C1b FAILURE retained but registered as an INVALID rejection

C1a_object_construction.unit: attempts on C1a-feasible-1 (5) plus the infeasible control (1)
C1a_object_construction.SUCCESS: >= 3 of 5 feasible attempts valid AND the infeasible control is handled correctly
C1a_object_construction.FAILURE: <= 2 valid (including 0) — an insufficient but JUDGEABLE outcome
C1a_object_construction.UNDECIDABLE: >= 3 of 5 attempts unparsable, or verifier/interface failure prevents judging
C1a_object_construction.counting_rule: each output judged individually by the frozen scorer; passing outputs are canonicalised; the SAME canonical object counts ONCE
C1a_object_construction.duplicate_policy: repeated identical objects never count as multiple discoveries

C1b_cross_domain_instantiation.SUCCESS: applicability correct on all 3 AND a valid conclusion on the applicable one
C1b_cross_domain_instantiation.FAILURE: any applicability decision wrong (including overclaiming on a non-applicable case)
C1b_cross_domain_instantiation.UNDECIDABLE: the lemma statement cannot be expressed/parsed for judging
C1b_cross_domain_instantiation.r2_semantics_note: SUCCESS/FAILURE are computed under the r2 field semantics below; in particular undefined hypotheses require an explicit null and missing fields are format violations, not nulls

C1c_compositional_dependency.SUCCESS: >= 1 attempt with valid conclusion AND cone uses both sources AND the frozen two-sided deletion test on the cone passes
C1c_compositional_dependency.FAILURE: 0 attempts satisfying all of the above (judgeable outcome)
C1c_compositional_dependency.UNDECIDABLE: >= 2 of 3 attempts unparsable, or dependency not expressible
C1c_compositional_dependency.interpretation_limit: C1c passing means at least one pre-specified output passed the frozen two-source dependency check; it does NOT represent the model's success rate on independent tasks, and does NOT prove general compositional discovery capability.

field_semantics_r2.true_false: judgement value of a DEFINED hypothesis
field_semantics_r2.null: the hypothesis is UNDEFINED under this instance preconditions
field_semantics_r2.missing: incomplete output / format violation; missing MUST NOT be equated with null
field_semantics_r2.defined_field_rule: must be present, boolean, and correct
field_semantics_r2.undefined_field_rule: must be explicit null; otherwise handled by the frozen format rules
field_semantics_r2.key_distinction: explicit null resolves OUTPUT AMBIGUITY only; it does not make the scorer mathematically correct, so every hypothesis keeps its own definability condition and truth logic

H3_tight.evidence: the formula uses both b and |C|

H4_no_complementary_pair.truth: no two blocks have complementary remainder parts
H4_no_complementary_pair.evidence: remainder parts are formed by removing the core, so uniform size is NOT required

states.PARTIAL_TRUNCATED: EXCLUDED from the capability verdict; reported as a separate completeness stratum (neither SUCCESS nor FAILURE)
states.UNCLASSIFIED_RESPONSE: UNDECIDABLE + flagged for human review; an unknown finish_reason or an unrecognised termination mode must never be silently mapped to a capability verdict

measurement_classification_r2.aggregation: a capability is judged only from SCOREABLE attempts; if every attempt is excluded (PARTIAL_TRUNCATED / MEASUREMENT_FAILURE / UNCLASSIFIED) the capability is UNDECIDABLE
